description:
Documentation audit (2026-04-01) found 10 CLI commands with NO documentation
and 13 flags on `benchbox run` that are undocumented.

Undocumented commands:
- benchbox visualize (benchbox/cli/commands/visualize.py)
- benchbox report (benchbox/cli/commands/report.py)
- benchbox metrics (benchbox/cli/commands/metrics.py)
- benchbox aggregate (benchbox/cli/commands/aggregate.py)
- benchbox datagen (benchbox/cli/commands/datagen.py)
- benchbox download-answers (benchbox/cli/commands/download_answers.py)
- benchbox plan-history (benchbox/cli/commands/plan_history.py)
- benchbox show-plan (benchbox/cli/commands/show_plan.py)
- benchbox setup (benchbox/cli/commands/setup.py)
- benchbox run-official (benchbox/cli/commands/run_official.py - hidden)

Undocumented `benchbox run` flags:
--table-mode, --table-format, --presort, --sorted-ingestion-mode,
--sorted-ingestion-method, --databricks-clustering-strategy,
--liquid-clustering-columns, --mode, --no-monitoring, --no-progress,
--ignore-memory-warnings, --global-cache, --plan-config

Some commands may be intentionally hidden (run-official). For those, a brief
internal note is sufficient rather than full public docs.

verifications.command: for cmd in visualize report metrics aggregate datagen setup; do [ -f docs/reference/cli/$cmd.md ] && echo "PASS: $cmd" || echo "FAIL: $cmd missing"; done
verifications.description: All non-hidden commands have doc pages

verifications.command: grep -c 'table-mode\|table-format\|presort\|plan-config\|no-monitoring\|no-progress\|ignore-memory-warnings\|global-cache\|mode' docs/reference/cli/run.md | xargs -I{} test {} -ge 8 && echo 'PASS: flags documented' || echo 'FAIL: flags missing'
for cmd in visualize report metrics aggregate datagen setup; do grep -qi $cmd docs/CLI_REFERENCE.md && echo "PASS: $cmd" || echo "FAIL: $cmd missing"; done

work_units.summary: Document general undocumented run flags (8 flags)
Create docs for report and metrics commands
Create docs for datagen, aggregate, and setup commands
Create docs for plan-history, show-plan, and download-answers
Update CLI_REFERENCE.md and index to list all commands
